create_PLRManager: create a PLRManager instance with an example level, UED score type, and configurable buffer size and replay probability
reset_PLRManager: reset the PLRManager to return a fresh PLRBuffer with zeroed scores, ages, and filled counts
sample_PLRManager: sample levels from the PLR buffer using score-weighted replay distribution or uniform random sampling
update_PLRManager: update the PLR buffer with new levels, UED scores, and mutation counts after environment evaluation
dedupe_levels_PLRManager: deduplicate levels against the PLR buffer using a comparator function to avoid redundant insertions
